message.elytrapitchhelper.config.reload_: could not reload config; your changes have been kept
message.elytrapitchhelper.config.newer_v: Config is in read-only safety mode; files were left untouched.
screen.elytrapitchhelper.save_conflict.d: Disk (-) compared with your in-game changes (+)
screen.elytrapitchhelper.save_failure.me: Your settings could not be written to disk, so your changes are still unsaved. Part of the save may already have reached disk, so files there can be a mix of old and new. No file was left half-written. Retry, stay in settings and keep editing, or discard your unsaved changes.
screen.elytrapitchhelper.save_failure.ne: This config directory holds data written by a newer version of Elytra Pitch Helper, so it is read-only. Update the mod, or move the config folder aside to start fresh.

tip.elytrapitchhelper.shift_scroll: Shift + scroll to adjust the setting under the cursor
tip.elytrapitchhelper.fold_section: Click a section name to collapse it
tip.elytrapitchhelper.expand_all: Search "expand" in the command palette to expand every section
tip.elytrapitchhelper.cycle_backwards: Right-click a cycling option to step backwards
tip.elytrapitchhelper.reset_setting: Modified settings show a ↺ action; Delete or Backspace resets the focused row
palette.elytrapitchhelper.title: Command Palette
screen.elytrapitchhelper.profiles.title: Profiles
screen.elytrapitchhelper.color.title: Edit %s
screen.elytrapitchhelper.reset_profile.m: This will restore all tuning settings in "%s" to their default values. The profile name is kept.
narration.elytrapitchhelper.setting_modi: modified; Delete or Backspace resets to default
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.reset_setting: When modified, click ↺ or press Delete or Backspace to restore the default.
screen.elytrapitchhelper.profile.name: Profile name
screen.elytrapitchhelper.commit_profile_: This will permanently delete 1 staged profile from disk.
This will permanently delete %s staged profiles from disk.
screen.elytrapitchhelper.cancel_profile_: You have 1 staged profile deletion. Leaving now will restore it and discard the delete queue.
You have %s staged profile deletions. Leaving now will restore them and discard the delete queue.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.color.custom.s: Which stripe the picker edits. Left-click or scroll to step, shift for the other way, and + or - to add and remove stripes.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.active: Make this profile the active flight profile.
This is the active flight profile. Its settings are the ones the mod uses.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.sort: Choose how profiles are ordered in this list.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.duplic: Create a copy of this profile without changing the active profile.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.reset_: Restore every tuning setting in this profile to its default. The name is kept.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.edit: Open this profile's settings without changing which profile is active.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.new: Create a default profile and keep it in the list so it can be named first.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.delete: Start deleting profiles, with this one already marked. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.mark_d: Add this profile to the batch waiting to be deleted.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.unmark: Take this profile back out of the batch.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.commit: Permanently delete the marked profiles after confirmation.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.open_j: Open this profile json in the operating system editor.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.open_p: Create, rename, copy and delete profiles. Escape brings you back to these settings.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.switch: Read another profile's settings. This does not change which profile is active; the active one is marked ●.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.profile.make_a: Fly with the profile shown here. Its settings are the ones the mod uses.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.enabled: Globally turns all Elytra Pitch Helper guides on or off.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.show_only_with: Only draws guides while a firework rocket is held.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.show_in_third_: Allows guides while using third-person camera views.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.target_up: Pitch target for the climb line. Minecraft uses negative pitch for looking up.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.target_down: Pitch target for the dive line. Positive pitch means looking down.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.tolerance: Angle window where a pitch guide fades in around its target.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.max_offset: Maximum distance a pitch guide can move away from the crosshair.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.offset_per_deg: How many pixels the guide moves per degree away from the target pitch.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.line_length: Horizontal length of each guide line.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.line_color: Base color of the pitch guide line, or a selected pride flag when pride mode is enabled.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.cue_flash_inte: Strength of the white flash fired when a cue or void warning triggers. At 0 the flash is off and the glow and color change still show the cue.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_help: Adds a turn-timing cue on the active guide without showing coordinates or speed numbers.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_trig: Height uses block change, Velocity uses horizontal speed, Either first uses whichever target is reached first.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_down: Drop distance that can trigger the dive cue in height/either mode.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_up: Rise distance that can trigger the climb cue in height/either mode.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_tole: Height range where the cue reaches full strength before the exact crossing pulse.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_down: Horizontal speed that flashes the dive cue and arms the climb cue in velocity/either mode.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_up_v: Horizontal speed that flashes the climb cue and arms the next dive cue in velocity/either mode.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_repe: Allows another dive-line cue after the previous dive flash fully ends, even before a climb cue fires.
Allows another climb-line cue after the previous climb flash fully ends, even before a dive cue fires.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.motion_glyphs: Shows a small directional gesture after each cue: pull up briskly after a dive cue, then release downward more gradually after a climb cue.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.pull_up_glyph_: Time the upward glyph takes to complete its pull-up motion.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.release_down_g: Time the downward glyph takes to complete its release motion. The default balances altitude gain against forward speed.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.amplitude_colo: Color used for the amplitude/velocity glow and flash cue, or a selected pride flag when pride mode is enabled.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.flight_detecti: Equipment check requires EPH to find an Elytra. Any elytra glide trusts Minecraft's active fall-flying state for custom flight items and equipment slots.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_warning: Blends the dive line toward the warning color as the detected or overridden void floor approaches.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_mode: Predicted uses fall speed. Simple uses Y height. Both stop warning when a collision block is below before the void floor.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_lookahead: Seconds of predicted fall time at which the warning begins fading in. Prediction mode also pulses at 5 s, 3 s, and 1 s.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_simple_bl: Distance above the detected or overridden void Y where simple mode begins fading in the warning.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_color: Color or pride flag the dive line blends toward as the void approaches.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.command_palett: Edit command palette shadow, blur, accent color, and base color for the current profile.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.flight_telemet: Logs detailed local flight metrics for testing and troubleshooting. May increase log size. No data is sent anywhere.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_tolerance: Uses a separate pitch tolerance while the void warning forces the dive line visible.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_custom_to: Pitch window used by the forced warning line when tolerance override is on.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_max_offse: Uses a separate maximum line offset while the void warning forces the dive line visible.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_custom_ma: Maximum warning-line distance from the crosshair when offset override is on.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_dimension: Dimension to set a custom void Y floor for.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_y_mode: Auto uses the world's minimum build height minus 48. Custom uses the Void Y slider for the selected dimension.
tooltip.elytrapitchhelper.void_y_overrid: Custom Y floor for the selected dimension.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.elytrapit: Shows pitch and relative height guides for energy-sustaining Elytra flight.
neoforge.screen.mods.info.description.el: Shows pitch and relative height guides for energy-sustaining Elytra flight.
